title: Pulp @ Radio City Music Hall
author: Mart Kawaii
body_html:
Ok. I will be very laconic about the Pulp show @ Radio City Music Hall yesteday.

I even didn’t took my big camera with me, cause I wanted it to be personal, to watch everything through my eyes, not through the LCD display.

And it was. It was amazing. I am a huge fan ot Pulp since my early teenage years and seeing them on few meters of me was a dream come true.

Jarvis’ presence and charisma are impressing and totally absorbing. He’s a great entertainer and musician and he’s my favourite man. Period. I will love him forever and he will never get fat.

I even cried from happiness. Only with the right eye though.

Jarvis fucked the stage performing “This is hardcore” and did so many quirky things that made the show totally unforgetable.

Radio City Hall is a great venue, very classy, a true institution & amazing sound.

I’ll still attach two of my blurry (hands shaking, wet… ahah I’m kidding *fingerscrossed*) pictures. A better gallery you can see in Brooklyn Vegan.

Nuff said. If you have the chance to see them live, just fucking do it.

Jarvis was throwing candies to the auditory.

JARVIS, I LOVE YOU!!!

Ok, enough.
